shots.focal_element: Two seated colleagues at a desk with a standing colleague leaning in between them, a monitor showing a Gantt-style schedule at right
shots.what_happens: Live-action wide master shot of an open-plan office in letterboxed widescreen; the man in the suit walks up behind the seated pair and leans in as the dialogue greets 'Nick' (w413-w415). The last 2 fps frame already shows the tighter over-monitor angle used in s065, so the cut lands just before the stated shot end.
shots.build_rebuild: Hold a locked-off wide live-action office plate with 2.39:1 letterbox bars and cut on the greeting line to the next angle; no graphics overlay.

shots.focal_element: Smiling standing man in suit looking down at the two seated colleagues
shots.what_happens: Tighter side angle framed past an out-of-focus monitor in the left foreground; the standing man smiles while asking what the pair are up to (w416-w422); the seated pair face the screen.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut to a medium shot through a defocused foreground monitor (shallow depth of field), the speaker placed on the upper-left third, held for about one line of dialogue.

shots.focal_element: Seated woman in burgundy blazer speaking, seated man beside her glancing sideways
shots.what_happens: Medium two-shot of the seated pair against a soft window background; the woman answers deadpan that she is talking about geese (w423-w427) while the man reacts. The final 2 fps frame at 2:19.000 already shows the over-monitor angle of s067, so the cut falls slightly before the stated boundary.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut to a medium two-shot with the speaker left and the reactor right against a blurred bright window, played for a deadpan line.

shots.focal_element: Standing man in suit looking down, speaking, seated pair in profile below
shots.what_happens: Return to the over-monitor side angle; the dialogue repeats 'geese' and begins the goose fact (w428-w432). The final 2 fps frame at 2:20.500 already shows the s068 two-shot, so the cut lands just before the boundary.
shots.build_rebuild: Reuse the s065 setup (defocused foreground monitor, standing speaker upper-left third) as the reverse in a shot/reverse-shot dialogue edit.

shots.focal_element: Seated man in brown quarter-zip delivering the goose fact, woman beside him staring blankly ahead
shots.what_happens: Medium two-shot of the seated pair; the man turns towards the standing colleague and says geese can swim 30 to 40 feet underwater, adding 'Also' (w433-w438), while the woman keeps a flat, unimpressed look for comic contrast.
shots.build_rebuild: Hold a static medium two-shot for the whole comedic line so the non-speaker's flat reaction plays alongside the speaker; no cutaway.

shots.focal_element: Standing man in suit beside the seated pair in the wide office, schedule monitor at right
shots.what_happens: Back to the wide master: after 'super long necks' and 'Great to know' (w439-w444) the standing man straightens up and starts to walk away behind the pair. The final 2 fps frame at 2:25.000 shows the over-monitor angle with him leaving, so the cut falls just before the stated end.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut back to the locked-off wide master to land the exchange's button line and let the standing character start his exit within the frame.
